title: Filmy Gaane
desc: A compilation of the greatest foot-tapping hits from Bollywood is played back to back in order to entertain the audience.

title: Golden Classics
desc: The host revisits and reviews classic Hindi films and their music, before sharing interesting trivia about their making.

title: Is Duniya Ke Sitare
desc: The host engages in a conversation with the popular celebrities of the entertainment industry about their personal lives and a variety of other topics.

title: Main Inteqam Loonga
desc: A man discovers the truth behind his father's tragic demise and vows to avenge him, oblivious to the consequences that await him.

title: Khandan
desc: Radha marries a kind-hearted Govind who is paralysed due to an accident. Though Govind highly respects his uncle and aunt, a property dispute forces them to live like strangers under the same roof.

title: Ayee Milan Ki Bela
desc: Shyam and Ranjeet are best friends who happen to fall in love with the same girl, which creates a rift between the two. In the misunderstandings that follow, Shyam is accused of stealing money.

title: Padosan
desc: Bhola enlists the help of his musician friends to woo the girl next door, Bindu, by making her think he is a great singer. But when the ruse is eventually discovered, it threatens their relationship.

title: Evergreen Mix
desc: A compilation of the promos of various movies that give an insight into their storylines while providing a behind-the-scenes look at their making.

title: Anari
desc: Raj, an honest man, finds himself in trouble when he is accused of killing his landlady who was poisoned. However, he escapes the law and sets out to find evidence to prove his innocence.
